label: Maxime-ens route operation-naming leaves: universal cause is maximal; naming from operation
summary: Baseline df4909cb0. Both leaves are premises only of 61ac44a6 (result 7280ac5f), one of three support bundles for the beec1dc1 premise e39a4fce; the others, 2dc44ef4 and e28fb989, come from the fuller naming 1ec205ed. On beec1dc1, e39a4fce is used only inside maximeEnsIsGod, and its GOD_2 output is consumed only with 777646a5 to identify first movers with the maximum. GOD_4 comes only from a594d8c4, so GOD_2 never passes into GOD_4. 57b88730 is derivable from route premises a9622441, 6c27657f, 101bdd62, d5a94eb1 (at esse only) and ee4ab504: a maximum z exists by the quarta via steps, and if z differs from a universal cause m, then m causes z's being, so m is more a being than z, which contradicts z's maximality. This was checked in a zero-axiom scratch Lean replica with the definitions copied verbatim; it is not registered. The direct supports of the five premises do not use the naming leaves. It is not a meaning postulate: the one-being interpretation in which no being has being satisfies d5a94eb1 and excluded middle but falsifies it (scratch needsSomeMaximum). 709ad5d2 is consumed at GOD_2, but its record carries the GOD_1 tag (18945900). truth semantics 61ac44a6 reports legacy allowlisted GOD_1/GOD_2 mixing, so the GOD_1 tag is a labelling defect. At GOD_1 (NominalGod) the statement would also require remoteness and the causation of every perfection, which nothing supplies. Under route premises, 709ad5d2 and e39a4fce are interderivable: 7280ac5f gives one direction, and the converse with d9fad785 at esse was scratch-checked (operationNamingFromReduced). The from-operation bundle therefore restates the reduced naming commitment and is not independent support. The materialized AQUINAS-ST-I-Q13-A8 passage (423cc2f7) was read in full. It imposes the name from universal providence (id a quo) to signify the divine nature, with the ratio supra omnia existens, principium omnium, remotum ab omnibus. The leaf substitutes causing being for providence and drops supra omnia and remotum, as an analyst inference supported but not stated by 9b52e1a5 (relation 7cc5ccee). Also instantiating God by the reduced description makes e39a4fce trivially true (scratch). The naming content then moves into reading 777646a5's q.105 a.5 claim at the named bearer.

current_assessment.scope: The two maxime-ens route (beec1dc1) leaves under e39a4fce through 61ac44a6, at GOD_2, MAXIME_ENS_1 and CAUSE_2 at esse, with one fixed InAct, MoreIn and CausesIn.
current_assessment.assessment: 57b88730: derivable, from five premises beec1dc1 already uses: a9622441, 6c27657f, 101bdd62, d5a94eb1 (at esse only) and ee4ab504. The derivation is scratch-checked and unregistered, and its warrant is theirs. It is not a meaning postulate, because without an existing maximum it fails in a one-being interpretation. No substantive objection to the inference was identified. 709ad5d2: a defended direct option. It is a reference-fixing nominal stipulation at GOD_2 and is not independent of e39a4fce: under route premises the two are interderivable (7280ac5f, and the scratch converse with d9fad785 at esse), so 61ac44a6 restates the reduced naming commitment and adds no warrant to e39a4fce. Its warrant is q.13 a.8 co. (the name is imposed from an operation) and the quarta via's 'et hoc dicimus Deum' (9b52e1a5, relation 7cc5ccee), as support rather than statement, plus the analyst substitutions (causing being for providence; supra omnia and remotum dropped). The dropped-remotum objection (world-form rival, q.13 a.8 ad 2, q.3 a.8) is answered conditionally, not refuted, by eaa4c679 and 09c6d5f0 with 57b88730: the inputs the sibling bundles already carry. No objection to its truth at GOD_2 meets the standard. The GOD_1 tag is a record defect, and the defense does not extend to GOD_1 (NominalGod). Route: on beec1dc1 GOD_2 never passes into GOD_4, and the naming leaves are not its binding constraint. Its support is bounded by the C*-dependent inputs c1b68c21 (absolute) and 777646a5 and by a594d8c4. Per accepted-but-unmerged #1768 and #1775, C* is weak, so the route is weakly supported overall on the current record; it would be moderate, bounded by a594d8c4, if C* is upgraded. Nothing is established, defeated or closed.
current_assessment.next_test: Register the 57b88730 derivation from a9622441, 6c27657f, 101bdd62, d5a94eb1 and ee4ab504 with the no-maximum omission control, and register the 709ad5d2 converse from e39a4fce, 57b88730 and d9fad785. Retag 709ad5d2 to GOD_2 (definition 23e73af5 in place of 18945900) and shrink the 61ac44a6 sense allowlist entry. Discriminating test: whether q.105 a.5's God, the source of 777646a5, can be read referentially as the unique maximal universal cause without importing C* a second time.
